translations.web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
translations.kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
translations.asv: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.
